title: Print Page

serves.summary: The learner taps the words on a page in reading order, left to right and top to bottom, and counts the words, which shows concepts of print: reading order and separate words with spaces.

request.topic: Concepts of print: reading order and words
request.objective: Show that print is read left to right and top to bottom, and that a sentence is made of separate words with spaces between them.

problems.ask: Where do we start reading on this page? Tap the first word.
problems.goal: One tap, on A, the first word of the line. The picture and the other words are not the start.

problems.ask: Tap each word, in the order we read them.
problems.goal: My, dog, can, run tapped once each, in that order.

problems.ask: This page has two lines. Tap each word in the order we read them.
problems.goal: We, can, see, then the, big, sun: the top line, then back to the left of the next line.

problems.ask: Tap each word as we read it. Then show how many words there are.
problems.goal: The, elephant, ate, a, bun tapped once each in order, and 5 chosen. The long word is one word and the one-letter word is a word.

problems.ask: This book is open to two pages. Tap each word in the order we read the book.
problems.goal: All six words of the left page, top line then next line, then all six of the right page the same way.
